summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases into a temp directory, unzips it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with string-array rotation and `_0xNNNN`-style identifier mangling, whose behavior cannot be determined by inspection. The advertised purpose of the package is an ESLint plugin (`lib/index.js` exports a small `check` rule), which is never referenced by the preinstall path and has no legitimate need for an alternate runtime or a compiled opaque bundle. Fetching an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at install time is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that also evades Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
